[[Ecruteak City]] }} '''Great Girafarig''' (Japanese: '''VS キリンリキ ''' ''VS {{tt|Kirinriki|Girafarig}}''), titled '''VS Girafarig''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 129th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 39th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} On {{rt|38|Johto}}, [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Harry]] challenges Eusine to a one-on-one battle. He tells Eusine that they are inside a web with electricity from {{p|Elekid}} and that [[Team Rocket]] is making a comeback in [[Johto]]. {{p|Girafarig}} uses {{m|Psywave}} on Eusine, who touches the web and gets electrocuted. Harry notes that since Ken is giving certain instructions to Elekid, Harry can't be shocked. Eusine, meanwhile, notes the state of his cloak. He then says that he will display his "Pokémon magic". He sends out a Pokémon and the Team Rocket Elite Trio is surprised. Meanwhile, Crystal rides on Eusine's {{p|Electrode}} through [[Ecruteak City]]. She recalls that it all started when {{p|Suicune}} emerged from the [[Burned Tower]]. Crystal then tells Electrode to go to the Burned Tower. Back on Route 38, Eusine has sent out his {{p|Jumpluff}} and Harry laughs at him sending out such a Pokémon. Eusine counts down and Jumpluff releases tons of spores with {{m|Cotton Spore}}. When it clears, the Team Rocket Elite Trio can't see Eusine. Harry directs Girafarig to search for Eusine's scent with its tail. They find Eusine crouched by a wall of the net. Harry tells Ken and Al to go after Suicune. Girafarig's tail bites Eusine, but it turns out that what they thought was Eusine was just a ball and Eusine's clothes. Girafarig's tail has bitten a pocket watch that is connected to the net, which electrocutes Harry and Girafarig. Eusine, wearing only underwear, appears in a hole in the ground and reveals his strategy to the unconscious Harry. He sprayed cologne on his watch so that Girafarig would be sure to bite it. Also, after Jumpluff used Cotton Spore, it planted a {{m|Leech Seed}} on Ken and Al. At that moment, Ken's {{p|Tauros}} faints from the Leech Seed. Meanwhile, Crystal stands near the Burned Tower. ==Major events== * [[Eusine]] battles the [[Team Rocket Elite Trio]]. * {{adv|Crystal}} arrives at the [[Burned Tower]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Crystal}} * [[Eusine]] * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken]] * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Al]] * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Harry]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Electrode}} ([[Eusine]]'s) * {{p|Jumpluff}} ([[Eusine]]'s) * {{p|Elekid}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken]]'s) * {{p|Tauros}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken]]'s) * {{p|Spinarak}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Al]]'s) * {{p|Girafarig}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Harry]]'s) * {{p|Suicune}} ({{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Suicune|Adventures}}; fantasy) ==Trivia== * At the end of this chapter, {{adv|Crystal}} has {{pkmn2|caught}} 142 Pokémon out of the 143 she found.
